panels.missing: The brand on Nagoji's left inner forearm is not drawn. His left arm is stretched out to her in the center of the frame with the inner forearm roughly facing us, and it has no mark at all. Everything else is there: the washing, the basin, her tight mouth, the tunic set aside, the rope burns, the squatting Fisherman and the hearth smoke.
